name: code-server
summary:
[Code-server](https://coder.com) is VS Code running on a remote server, accessible through the browser.
- Code on your Chromebook, tablet, and laptop with a consistent dev environment.
- If you have a Windows or Mac workstation, more easily develop for Linux.
- Take advantage of large cloud servers to speed up tests, compilations, downloads, and more.
- Preserve battery life when you're on the go.
- All intensive computation runs on your server.
- You're no longer running excess instances of Chrome.

env.name: PASSWORD
env.description: Optional web gui password, if `PASSWORD` or `HASHED_PASSWORD` is not provided, there will be no auth.

env.name: HASHED_PASSWORD
env.description: Optional web gui password, overrides `PASSWORD`, instructions on how to create it is below.

env.name: SUDO_PASSWORD
env.description: If this optional variable is set, user will have sudo access in the code-server terminal with the specified password.

env.name: SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH
env.description: Optionally set sudo password via hash (takes priority over `SUDO_PASSWORD` var). Format is `$type$salt$hashed`.

env.name: PROXY_DOMAIN
env.description: If this optional variable is set, this domain will be proxied for subdomain proxying. See [Documentation](https://github.com/coder/code-server/blob/main/docs/guide.md#using-a-subdomain)

env.name: DEFAULT_WORKSPACE
env.description: If this optional variable is set, code-server will open this directory by default

env.name: PWA_APPNAME
env.description: If this optional variable is set, the PWA app will the specified name.

readonly.notes:
* `/tmp` must be mounted to tmpfs
* `sudo` will not be available

docs.setup:
Access the webui at `http://<your-ip>:8443`.
For github integration, drop your ssh key in to `/config/.ssh`.
Then open a terminal from the top menu and set your github username and email via the following commands

```bash
git config --global user.name "username"
git config --global user.email "email address"
```

### Hashed code-server password

How to create the [hashed password](https://github.com/cdr/code-server/blob/master/docs/FAQ.md#can-i-store-my-password-hashed).

changelog.text: Add fallback for legacy or misconfigured systems without IPv6 support.
Fix container only listening on IPv6 when running non-root.
Let server listen on both ipv4 and ipv6.
Allow setting PWA name using env var `PWA_APPNAME`.
Only chown config folder when change to ownership or new install is detected.
Manage permissions in /config/.ssh according to file type
Rebase to Ubuntu Noble.
Deprecate armhf. As announced [here](https://www.linuxserver.io/blog/a-farewell-to-arm-hf)
Install recommended deps to maintain parity with the older images.
Rebase to jammy, switch to s6v3. Fix chown logic to skip `/config/workspace` contents.
Install using the official tarballs.
Add `install-extension` as a helper for mods to install extensions.
Add `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE` env var.
Rebase to Ubuntu focal.
Fix slow `chown` on large workspace (contents of workspace folder no longer chowned).
Bump node to 14 to fix builds
Fix doc link
Allow setting gui password via hash using env var `HASHED_PASSWORD`.
Allow setting sudo password via hash using env var `SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH`.
Add --domain-proxy support.
Shrink images, install via yarn, fix arm32v7 build.
Switch to multi-arch images, install via npm.
Update start arguments.
Structural changes required for v3.
Fix artifact url retrieval from github.
Upgrade to v2 builds.
Update project logo.
Add development builds/tag.
Add optional sudo access.
Add nano.
Initial Release.
